ProductPageScenes.appShellAlt: The TManage team workspace: the Atlas Website Relaunch project with its stage track, a task table and the details panel of Homepage Concept v2.
ProductPageScenes.workListAlt: The Delivery risk saved view: work items grouped by milestone with owner, state, and committed and forecast dates kept apart.
ProductPageScenes.inboxAlt: The focus inbox: notifications bundled by object, with the one approval that needs you first.
ProductPageScenes.portalAlt: The client portal for Atlas Hospitality: 47 days to launch, one action waiting, and the homepage direction approval first.
ProductPageScenes.adminAlt: The control center: an offboarding decision with its impact first, policy counts and the audit trail of recent changes.
ProductPageScenes.bilingualAlt: The same studio settings card twice: left-to-right in English and mirrored right-to-left in Arabic.
SecurityScenes.offboardingAlt: The offboarding run for Karim Nabil: four of six steps done, sessions being revoked, and an immutable receipt for the audit log.
SecurityScenes.auditLogAlt: The audit log: 612 events with who changed what, an event id and a class, and the detail of one client-visibility change.
SecurityScenes.publicationAlt: The safety check before publishing Homepage Concept v2: two client reviewers, the internal content excluded, one warning, and the true client projection beside it.
SecurityScenes.approvalAlt: A client approval card: the exact version being decided on, four things to confirm and the Approve version 2 button.
SolutionsAgenciesScenes.portfolioAlt: The Northstar Studio portfolio: five client projects across four clients, one in client review and one blocked.
SolutionsAgenciesScenes.clientBoundaries: Three client organizations, each with its own portal that shows only its own projects.
SolutionsAgenciesScenes.creativeReviewAl: Homepage Concept v2 in client review: three criteria, the earlier version superseded and Salma Riad's approval recorded on v2.
SolutionsAgenciesScenes.retainerPlanAlt: The Lumen Travel October retainer plan: four recurring requests, eleven of sixteen agreed days committed.
ConsultanciesScenes.decisionRegisterAlt: The decision register: five decisions with an owner, an effective date and the work each one affects; one is superseded by a newer decision.
ConsultanciesScenes.engagementStoryAlt: An engagement's Work Story: scoping, discovery findings, a published concept, and the client decision it is waiting on now.
ConsultanciesScenes.decisionDetailAlt: A decision record with its owner, rationale, supporting evidence, related items and an audit trail of who recorded and approved it.

PricingPage.faqSwitchAnswer: Yes. Move up or down at any time. The change applies from your next billing period.

PricingPage.faqEnterpriseAnswer: Enterprise is quoted per contract, based on seats and your security review.

PricingPage.basecampBody: A 12-person team pays $180 a month on Basecamp's per-user plan. On TManage Studio it is $49 flat, and your clients never count.

PricingPage.faqFlatLede: Still unsure? Book a demo and we will walk through your setup with you.
PricingPage.faqPersonQuestion: Who counts as an internal person?
PricingPage.faqPersonAnswer: Anyone on your team with an internal login. Clients, guests and approvers are always free and never count.
PricingPage.faqFoundingQuestion: What does the founding offer include?
PricingPage.faqFoundingAnswer: The first 50 workspaces get 40 % off any paid plan for 12 months, and their price is locked for 24 months.
PricingPage.faqFreePlanQuestion: What happens on the Free plan?
PricingPage.faqFreePlanAnswer: Up to 3 internal people and 3 active projects, with unlimited clients and no time limit.
PricingPage.faqSsoQuestion: Do you support SAML single sign-on or SCIM?
PricingPage.faqSsoAnswer: Not yet. Google sign-in and two-step codes are available on every plan. SAML and SCIM are planned for Business and Enterprise; the integrations page shows the current status.

Privacy.signInBody: When you sign in we store the IP address, the browser's user agent, the time and an automated-sign-in hint with its reasons. We look up the approximate place of the IP (city level, from the free DB-IP Lite database) and the network that owns it. A company's owners and admins can see this for their members' sessions, you can see it for your own, and TManage platform staff with security rights can see it to protect accounts. It is kept with the security audit trail and deleted when that retention ends (at most 400 days).

DevelopersPage.title: Build on the TManage API.
DevelopersPage.lede: Connect your tools with a token or OAuth, stay inside the rate limits, receive signed webhooks and look up every endpoint.
DevelopersPage.authLede: Every request acts as one member of one workspace. The API checks that member’s permissions on every call.

DevelopersPage.limitsLede: Over a limit, the API answers 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header. Wait that many seconds, then try again.
DevelopersPage.limitPublicValue: 120 a minute, 2,000 an hour per address
DevelopersPage.webhooksLede: Each delivery is signed. Check X-TManage-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp and body) and refuse a timestamp more than 5 minutes off.
DevelopersPage.referenceLede: Every endpoint of the contract, grouped by area.

ChatMessages.refused.archive_off: “{name}” is an archive, and archives (ZIP, 7z, RAR) are turned off for this workspace.
ChatMessages.refused.double_extension: “{name}” has two file types in its name, which TManage refuses for safety. Rename it and attach it again.
ChatMessages.refused.type_not_allowed: “{name}” is a file type this workspace does not accept.
ChatMessages.refused.too_large: “{name}” is larger than this workspace allows.
ChatMessages.refused.archive_contains_bl: “{name}” contains “{entry}”, a program, script or macro file, which TManage does not accept. Remove it from the archive and attach it again.
ChatMessages.refused.archive_nested: “{name}” contains another archive, “{entry}”. TManage looks inside one level only: unpack it, or send the inner archive on its own.
ChatMessages.refused.archive_encrypted: “{name}” contains a password-protected file, “{entry}”, which TManage cannot check. Send it without a password.
ChatMessages.refused.archive_unreadable: TManage could not look inside “{name}”, so it cannot be shared.
ChatMessages.refused.nothingSent: Nothing was sent; your message and the other files are still here.

NavHelp.files: Every file your projects have produced, in one place.
FilesHub.valueLine: Every file your projects have produced, newest first. Open one to view it, comment on it or download it.
FilesHub.emptyBody: Files attached to work, chat messages, docs and deliverables show here.
FilesHub.uploadTip: Add files to the chosen project. You can also drop files anywhere on this page. Only your team sees them until you share them.
FilesHub.dropPickProject: Choose a project above first, then drop the files.
FilesHub.pickProjectBody: Files belong to a project. Pick one of the projects above, then upload again.
FileDelete.title: Delete “{name}”?
FileDelete.body: It is removed from Files and from every message and work item it is attached to. The messages and docs themselves stay. You can undo this straight after.
MeetingPage.savedNoGuests: Saved. It is in your {calendar} calendar.
MeetingPage.removeBody: It leaves the calendar for everyone. Nobody is notified again, because the meeting is already cancelled.
BrandColour.title: Brand colour
BrandColour.intro: Use your company's colour instead of the TManage lime. Buttons, the current item and Done work take it, for everyone in this workspace.
BrandColour.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can change the brand colour.
BrandColour.saveFailed: The colour was not saved. Try again.
BrandColour.saved: Saved. Everyone in the workspace now sees this colour.
WorkListScreen.reorderHandle: Move {title}: up and down arrow keys
WorkListScreen.reorderHint: Drag to reorder, or use the up and down arrow keys
DocEditor.upload.busy: TManage was busy and “{name}” did not upload. Try again in a moment.
DocEditor.upload.rejected: “{name}” did not pass the safety check, so it cannot be added.
DocEditor.upload.still_checking: “{name}” uploaded and is still being checked for safety. Try again in a minute.
DocEditor.upload.refused: “{name}” could not be uploaded. Try again.
ConnectorDirectory.keysTitle: Apps that connect with a key
ConnectorDirectory.keysHint: GitHub and Jira do not offer a one-click sign-in to TManage yet. An owner or admin pastes a key from the app once; it is stored encrypted and never shown again.
IntegrationDirectoryScreen.lede: Connect the apps your team already uses. Most take one click; Jira asks once for a key from the app. You can disconnect any time.
IntegrationDirectoryScreen.scopePersonal: Just for you: your own Figma account
IntegrationDirectoryScreen.askAdmin: An owner or admin connects this for the company.
IntegrationDirectoryScreen.what.jira: Bring Jira issues into TManage and keep them in step.
IntegrationDirectoryScreen.figmaFailed: Figma did not finish the sign-in, so nothing was changed. Press Connect to try again.
ConnectedApps.elsewhereTitle: Drive, calendars, Figma and other apps
ConnectedApps.elsewhereBody: They are all on the Integrations page, with one Connect button each.
ConnectedApps.memberCalendars: Your own calendar connects from Calendar settings.
AppConnect.failedBody: {app} did not finish the sign-in, so nothing was changed. Press Connect to try again.
AppConnect.scopeTooWide: {app} gave TManage more access than it asks for, so TManage refused the connection and gave the access back. Press Connect again and keep the requested access as it is.
AppConnect.heading: Your connected apps
AppConnect.advancedHint: Most companies only need Connect. If you already have a GitHub access token, you can still use it.
AppConnect.disconnectConfirmGithub: TManage forgets its access to your GitHub account. Repository webhooks keep working.
AutoTimer.state.unsupported: Off in this browser · the timer still works
AutoTimer.help.tracking: Your computer is in use, so your time is being counted. It pauses by itself when you step away.
AutoTimer.help.pausedIdle: No keyboard or mouse use for a while, so counting stopped at your last activity. It starts again when you come back.
AutoTimer.help.pausedLocked: Your screen is locked, so counting stopped. It starts again when you unlock and work.
AutoTimer.help.pausedAsleep: Your computer was asleep, so counting stopped. It starts again when you work.
AutoTimer.help.manual: A manual timer is running and counts this time, so the automatic timer waits until you stop it.
AutoTimer.help.needsPermission: Your browser asks once before TManage can tell whether your computer is in use. Open the timer to allow it.
AutoTimer.help.unsupported: The timer works here. Automatic tracking needs the TManage desktop app, or Chrome or Edge on a computer.
AutoTimer.help.off: Automatic tracking is off. Open the timer to turn it on.
AutoTimer.name: Auto timer
AutoTimer.intro: Counts your time while you use your computer, in any app, and pauses when you step away or lock the screen. No need to start or stop it.
AutoTimer.unsupported: The timer works here. Automatic tracking needs to know when your computer is in use, and this browser cannot tell. For that, use the TManage desktop app, or Chrome or Edge on a computer.
AutoTimer.taskHidden: A task you can no longer open
AutoTimer.privacy: Only whether you are active or idle, and the times, are recorded. No screenshots, keystrokes, app or window names, or web addresses.
AutoTimer.visibility: Your tracked time and current task are visible to your workspace owner and admins, and to people they authorize.
AutoTimePolicy.offHint: Nobody in the company uses the automatic timer. The manual timer stays.
AutoTimePolicy.optionalHint: People turn "Track my time automatically" on or off for themselves.
AutoTimePolicy.title: Automatic time tracking
AutoTimePolicy.intro: The automatic timer counts working time while a person uses their computer and pauses when they step away. Only active or idle state and times are recorded: no screenshots, keystrokes, app names or web addresses.
AutoTimePolicy.loadError: The setting could not be loaded.
AutoTimePolicy.saveError: The setting was not saved. Try again.
AutoTimePolicy.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can change this.
TeamTime.title: Team time
TeamTime.description: See who is working now and how much time each person tracked. Only active or idle state and times are recorded.
TeamTime.noAccessBody: Team time is for the company owner, admins and people an admin authorized. You can see your own time in Timesheets.
TeamTime.loadError: Team time could not be loaded
TeamTime.empty: Nobody tracked time in this range.
TeamTime.dayError: The day could not be loaded
TeamTime.dayEmpty: No time tracked on this day.
TeamTime.readOnly: This view is read-only. To correct time, use Timesheets.
AuditActionLabel.organization.client_fil: Changed which files clients can receive
FinanceTimesheets.reviewBody: A day over 12 hours, a session over 6 hours without a break, or time filed late because its week was closed. Check it before you submit.
ClientFilePolicy.title: Files clients can receive
ClientFilePolicy.intro: Choose which files your team can send to clients in the portal.
ClientFilePolicy.checkedLabel: Files that passed the safety check
ClientFilePolicy.checkedHint: TManage checks every file: it reads the real file type, refuses programs and Office files with macros, and looks inside ZIP and Office files. Clients see these files marked Checked.
ClientFilePolicy.scannedHint: Clients receive a file only after a virus scanner has cleared it.
ClientFilePolicy.nothingCanBeShared: No virus scanner is set up, so with this choice no file can be sent to clients. Choose “Files that passed the safety check” to share files now.
PermissionMatrix.cap.finance.manage: Manage finance settings, tax and exchange rates
AuditActionLabel.organization.time_round: Changed how timer time is rounded
AuditActionLabel.deliverable.shared_with: Shared a deliverable with the client
TimeRounding.title: Timer rounding
TimeRounding.intro: When someone stops the manual timer, the time is rounded up to this step before it is saved. Automatic time is never rounded.
TimeRounding.label: Round timer time up to
TimeRounding.hint: Applies to time saved from now on. Entries already saved keep their minutes.
TimeRounding.loadError: The setting could not be loaded.
TimeRounding.saveError: The setting was not saved. Try again.
TimeRounding.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can change this.
Timer.roundedUp.zero: rounded up to the nearest {count} minutes
Timer.roundedUp.one: rounded up to the nearest minute
Timer.roundedUp.two: rounded up to the nearest {count} minutes
Timer.roundedUp.few: rounded up to the nearest {count} minutes
Timer.roundedUp.many: rounded up to the nearest {count} minutes
Timer.roundedUp.other: rounded up to the nearest {count} minutes
AutoTimer.help.blocked: Your browser blocked activity detection for TManage. Open the timer to see how to allow it.
AutoTimer.help.policyOff: Your workspace owner switched automatic tracking off. Time counted before that was saved up to your last activity.
AutoTimer.policyOffBody: Your workspace owner switched automatic tracking off. Time counted before that was saved up to your last activity, and you find it in your timesheet.
AutoTimer.policyOffManual: You can still use the manual timer on any task.
AutoTimer.requiredLine: Your workspace owner turned this on for everyone. It starts by itself when you are signed in.
AutoTimer.turnOnWhy: Your browser asks once whether TManage may know when your computer is in use, so your time counts without you starting anything.
AutoTimer.turnOnWhyDesktop: Your time then counts while you use your computer, without you starting anything.
AutoTimer.blockedSteps: Click the lock icon to the left of the web address, set "Idle detection" to Allow, then reload this page.
AutoTimer.startWithComputerHint: TManage opens in the tray when you sign in to your computer, so tracking starts by itself.
AutoTimer.workOnThisHelp: Your automatic time goes to this task from now on. Time before stays where it was.
AutoTimer.workingOnThisHelp: Your automatic time goes to this task. Press to stop: time from then on stays unassigned.
AutoTimePolicy.requiredHintAll: Automatic tracking is on for every person. There is nothing for them to switch on or off.
AutoTimePolicy.requiredDesktopNote: For fully automatic tracking with nothing to click, people use the TManage desktop app. In Chrome or Edge, each person clicks Allow once.
AutoTimePolicy.awayHint: The same for everyone. After this long without keyboard or mouse use the timer pauses, and it continues when they are back. Away minutes are never counted.
FinanceIndex.teamTimeBody: Who is tracking now, and each person’s time today and this week.
UnassignedTime.intro: Time with no task chosen. Put it on a task, all of it or part of it, or delete what you do not want kept.
UnassignedTime.readOnly: This week cannot be changed now, so its unassigned time stays as it is.
UnassignedTime.deleteConfirm: Delete this time? It cannot be brought back.
UnassignedTime.minutesHint: All of it, or part: the rest stays unassigned.
AutoTimer.pausesAfter.zero: It pauses by itself after {count} minutes without keyboard or mouse use, and continues when you are back.
AutoTimer.pausesAfter.one: It pauses by itself after {count} minute without keyboard or mouse use, and continues when you are back.
AutoTimer.pausesAfter.two: It pauses by itself after {count} minutes without keyboard or mouse use, and continues when you are back.
AutoTimer.pausesAfter.few: It pauses by itself after {count} minutes without keyboard or mouse use, and continues when you are back.
AutoTimer.pausesAfter.many: It pauses by itself after {count} minutes without keyboard or mouse use, and continues when you are back.
AutoTimer.pausesAfter.other: It pauses by itself after {count} minutes without keyboard or mouse use, and continues when you are back.
Timer.tooShort: This timer ran for less than a minute, so discarding it is the default. You can still save it.
Timer.minutesToSaveHint: You can lower this, down to 1 minute. It cannot be more than {max}.
Timer.discardConfirm: Discard this timer? No time is saved, and this cannot be undone.
AutoTimer.noTaskButton: No task chosen. Your time is kept as unassigned time. In your timesheet you can put it on a task, split it or delete it. To choose a task now, open it and press "{button}".
FinanceTimesheets.automaticFriendly: Automatic time comes from your device activity. Days follow the company time zone.
TeamTime.rangeHintShort: Up to 62 days, in the company time zone ({zone}).
TeamTime.howCountedBody: Automatic time comes from each person’s own computer activity; TManage does not check it further. Time with no task chosen counts as unassigned time. A day over 12 hours, or a session over 6 hours without a break, is marked for review. You also see where each person’s tracking runs: the desktop app, or a browser and whether it was allowed.
Roles.owner.label: Owner
Roles.owner.grant1: Everything an organization admin can do
Roles.owner.withholds: There is nothing an owner cannot do. Grant it deliberately.
Roles.org_admin.label: Organization admin
Roles.org_admin.grant1: Everything a team member can do, in every project
Roles.org_admin.grant2: Invite people and change their roles
Roles.org_admin.grant3: Set up client organizations and share projects with them
Roles.org_admin.withholds: Cannot make anyone an owner, remove an owner or delete the organization.
Roles.workspace_admin.label: Workspace admin
Roles.workspace_admin.grant1: Everything a team member can do, in their workspace
Roles.workspace_admin.grant2: Create and archive projects in that workspace
Roles.workspace_admin.withholds: Cannot invite people to the organization or change anybody’s role.
Roles.manager.label: Manager
Roles.manager.grant1: Every project they are assigned to
Roles.manager.grant2: Publish work and deliverables to clients
Roles.manager.grant3: Triage client requests and commit to dates
Roles.manager.withholds: Cannot invite people to the organization or change anybody’s role.
Roles.moderator.label: Moderator
Roles.moderator.grant1: Every project they are assigned to
Roles.moderator.grant2: Moderate conversations: edit and remove messages
Roles.moderator.withholds: Cannot publish to clients or change anybody’s role.
Roles.member.label: Team member
Roles.member.grant1: Every internal project they are assigned to
Roles.member.grant2: Chat channels they join, plus project channels
Roles.member.grant3: Work, docs and files in their projects
Roles.member.withholds: Cannot change roles, publish to clients, or open the Control Center.
Roles.guest.label: Freelancer or partner
Roles.guest.grant1: Someone outside your company who is not a client, such as a freelancer or a partner agency
Roles.guest.grant2: Read-only access to the projects they are added to
Roles.guest.withholds: Cannot change anything. Not for clients: clients are invited to their own portal, separately.
Roles.platform_support.label: TManage support
Roles.platform_support.grant1: Everything an owner can do, for the length of a recorded support visit
Roles.platform_support.withholds: Cannot be given to anyone from this workspace.
Roles.client_admin.label: Client admin
Roles.client_admin.grant1: Their client portal: shared projects, milestones, updates and files
Roles.client_admin.grant2: Send requests and, where your policy allows, approve deliverables
Roles.client_admin.grant3: Invite other people from their own client organization
Roles.client_admin.withholds: Never sees your internal projects, notes, costs or other clients.
Roles.client_reviewer.label: Client reviewer
Roles.client_reviewer.grant1: The projects shared with them in their client portal
Roles.client_reviewer.grant2: Review and approve the deliverables assigned to them, and send requests
Roles.client_reviewer.withholds: Never sees your internal projects, notes, costs or other clients.
Roles.client_member.label: Client member
Roles.client_member.grant1: The projects shared with them in their client portal
Roles.client_member.grant2: Send requests and complete actions asked of them
Roles.client_member.withholds: Cannot invite anyone, and approves only what is assigned to them.
Roles.client_viewer.label: Client viewer
Roles.client_viewer.grant1: Read-only view of what is shared with them in their client portal
Roles.unknown.grant1: This role is not described here yet.
Roles.unknown.withholds: Check the permission matrix before sending this invitation.
PersonProfileScreen.onProjects.zero: On {count} projects in this organization, {active} of them active.

PreviewAsClient.label: Preview as client
PreviewAsClient.tip: Open the client portal the way your client sees it. Nothing you do there is sent to them.
ShareFile.title: Share “{name}” with your client
ShareFile.body: Your client will see this file in the portal as a new deliverable, and can open and comment on it. Nobody is e-mailed. Want a sign-off too? Ask for approval from the deliverable afterwards.
ShareFile.doneBody: Your client can now open this file in the portal. Nobody was e-mailed.
ShareFile.fromDeliverable: This file is a version of a deliverable. Share it from the deliverable page, where you can also ask for approval.
ShareFile.loading: Checking who can see this project
ShareFile.noClient: No client can open this project yet. Add the client company to the project and invite someone from it; then you can share files with them.
ShareFile.notAllowed: Only the owner or a project manager can share files with clients.
ShareFile.notUsable: This file belongs to a task or a message, so it cannot be sent on its own. Upload it to a deliverable instead.
DeliverableDelete.tip: Delete this deliverable if it was made by mistake. It leaves the client portal too. You can undo it.
DeliverableDelete.title: Delete “{name}”?
DeliverableDelete.body: It leaves the deliverables list, and your client no longer sees it in the portal. Its files stay in Files. You can undo this for a few seconds.
CloudFolders.title: Live folders
CloudFolders.tip: Add a folder from your company's Google Drive or OneDrive. Its files are shown live, and the client sees them in the portal when this work is shared with them.
CloudFolders.loadError: The folder can't be read right now. Try again in a moment.
PortalJourney.title: Your project
PortalJourney.empty: Your project plan will appear here once {provider} shares it. You can send a message any time.
PortalJourney.errorTitle: We could not load your project steps
PortalJourney.errorBody: Your work is safe. Please try again.
PortalJourney.allDoneBodyOn: {provider} handed over the final files on {date}. Thank you for working with us.
PortalJourney.allDoneBody: {provider} handed over the final files. Thank you for working with us.
PortalJourney.turnBody: {provider} sent it on {date}. It takes about 10 minutes. The next step starts as soon as you answer.
PortalJourney.workingBody: Nothing needs you right now. We will tell you when it is your turn.
PortalJourney.next1: Once you approve, {provider} starts the next step.
PortalJourney.next2: You get an e-mail when there is something new for you.
PortalJourney.next3: If you ask for changes, the plan moves and we tell you the new date.
PortalJourney.formBody: {provider} needs a few answers from you. It takes a few minutes.
PortalJourney.uploadBody: Send the files {provider} asked for. You can add them on your Files page.
PortalJourney.signBody: Read the document and sign it here. It takes about 2 minutes.
PortalJourney.meetingBody: Check the time and let {provider} know you can come.

ApprovalRecord.changedBody: This file is not the one {name} approved.
ApprovalRecord.verifiedBody: The file matches what was approved.

ApprovalRecord.sentenceChanges: {name} asked for changes to version {version} of “{title}” on {date}.

ApprovalRecord.noRecord: There is no sealed decision for this approval yet.

platformCapacity.title: Server capacity
platformCapacity.intro: How close TManage is to the limits of its hosting plan.
platformCapacity.help: TManage runs on shared hosting with fixed limits for memory, files, disk and database connections. At Watch, plan a clean-up; at Act now, do it today.
platformCapacity.errorTitle: Server capacity could not be loaded
platformCapacity.noReadings: No readings yet. The first one appears a few minutes after the app starts.
platformCapacity.planningLimits: These limits are planning figures until the real plan limits are entered.
platformCapacity.moveDue: A limit has been at Act now for {days} days in a row. It is time to move to a bigger server.
platformCapacity.ramHint: Memory the app is using, against what the plan allows for one app.
platformCapacity.ramAdvice: Restart the app quietly from the hosting panel, then look for a job that keeps growing.
platformCapacity.loopLagHint: How long a request waits before the app can start on it. Lower is better.
platformCapacity.loopLagAdvice: Look for a slow report or import running now, and move heavy jobs to the night.
platformCapacity.socketsHint: Live connections from browsers and services at the same moment.
platformCapacity.socketsAdvice: Many people are online at once. If this stays high, plan a bigger server.
platformCapacity.inodesHint: How many files and folders the app keeps. Shared hosting limits the count, not only the size.
platformCapacity.inodesAdvice: Remove old exports, previews and logs from the app's storage.
platformCapacity.diskHint: Space the app uses on the server disk.
platformCapacity.diskAdvice: Move old files to connected Drive or OneDrive storage and delete old exports.
platformCapacity.dbConnectionsHint: Database connections open at the same moment.
platformCapacity.dbConnectionsAdvice: Too many database requests at once. Check for a stuck job before sign-ins slow down.
platformServices.title: Connected services
platformServices.switchHelp: Switching a service off stops it on the server for every workspace. Nothing is deleted, and you can turn it back on at any time.
platformServices.alwaysOnHelp: Sign-in, password and invitation e-mails must never stop, so e-mail sending has no switch.
platformServices.offBody: Workspaces can no longer connect or use {name} until you turn it back on. Nothing is deleted: their connections stay and work again as soon as it is on.
platformServices.onBody: Workspaces can connect and use {name} again. Their earlier connections come back as they were.
EmptyStates.filesBody: Keep briefs, designs and deliverables with the project they belong to, and share them with clients when they are ready.
platformServices.pausedBody: TManage has paused this service for now. Nothing is lost: your connection is kept. Try again later.

teachEmpty.automationRunsBody: Each time an automation runs, you can see here what it did and whether it worked.

teachEmpty.reportSchedulesBody: Send a report to the right people on a regular rhythm, without building it each time.
